best_idea: A tame or command is one skill-window roll with a loyalty penalty, and loyalty itself moves per command (+1 or -3), is refilled by feeding, and decays on an hourly pass until the pet is released at zero.
decision_why: Take the skill-window roll and the loyalty meter as catalogue fields on one server clock; drop the 95 percent random anger on tame start and the mid-attempt loss on damage, which conflict with server-verified outcomes. Pick one control formula (pre-ML) because the two branches disagree.
acceptance: A server test with MinTameSkill 50 and a tamer with taming 60.0 and lore 50.0 expects command chance 0.99 at loyalty 100 and 0.79 at loyalty 80; a failed command drops loyalty by 3; a companion at loyalty 5 is released after the hourly pass with loyalty reset to 100.
